title: 17501 - 17501/P1093/004243
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Fuel Pressure (on FSI engines High and Low Fuel Pressure System)
Kontrol edin:  Fuel Pump (High Pressure System)
Kontrol edin:  Fuel Pressure Regulator Valve (N276)
Kontrol edin:  Fuel Filter and Filter in Fuel Pump Casing
technicalNotes:

Kontrol edin:  TSB/TPI 2008753 (Rest of World), incompatibility between Fuel Pressure Regulator Valve (N276) and ECU software.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: conjunction with Misfires and Lean fault codes, Kontrol edin: RVUTB: 01-09-03  or  2018919 (NAR only) 2.0T (BPY), for updated Crankcase Breather Valve
If the breather valve is faulty, full engine vacuum is typically found when removing the oil cap at idle.
